profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GDIT
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Defense & Space industry. Skilled in C++, Java, Teamwork, Team Leadership, and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Science from Purdue University.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked in a team setting to modernize legacy applications using Appian, SAIL, and Atlassian products
o Created reports using SAIL Forms, Custom Data Types, and Database Views
o Extensively worked on SAIL Forms, Constants, Expression Rules, and Query Entity Rules
o Used Jira and Confluence to track development progress and product documentation
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Government · Confluence · Scrum · Appian

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked in an agile software development team using scrum to upgrade and maintain various functionality in order to release major
and minor patches for customers
• Operated as a Backend Developer to resolve issues presented by the customer
o Maintained and created Java and Groovy code for use in a Linux environment
o Used Git to manage and track software changes

positions.title: Associate Cyber Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with customers to design and develop new software solutions to improve the functionality of the system
o Created and updated Java, C, and JavaScript code in a Linux environment
o Performed unit and integration tests to successfully assimilate functional code into the project
• Performed maintenance tasks to increase and maintain the overall health of the project

positions.title: Software Analyst Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented an automated process workflow in JIRA for the onboarding process 
•	Increased the quality of legacy code by using SonarQube to improve security and code quality 
•	Updated the components of the DTS application to increase usability as well as modernize the system
•	Resolved user reported Help Desk issues for the DTS application

positions.title: Data Systems Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed an updated repair schedule with improved functionality using C#, SQL, and Microsoft Visual Studios
o	Added the ability to create custom queries to streamline the information being shown to users
o	Improved usability by simplifying the User Interface (UI)
•	Created, maintained, and modified databases and queries using Microsoft Access

positions.title: Ground Test Operations Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked with the Missile Defense Agency to conduct ground test operations
•	Modified test data collection scripts to become more efficient
•	Improved knowledge of BASH scripting within a Linux environment
